observations: Torah #147 does not generate any new cross-Torah package types. The teaching organizes around one axis — the polarity between holy boldness (עזות דקדשה) and evil impudence (עזות פנים / עזות דסטרא אחרא) — and this axis maps cleanly onto the established good/evil mirror structure documented in the framework. Specifically: (1) The 'holy empowerment / arousal from below' domain (Package 1) is a well-established type across many Torahs. The concept of אתערותא דלתתא appears in numerous Torahs as a cross-Torah bridge node. עזות דקדשה as a specific expression of holy empowerment is new to Torah #147 but does not define a new package type — it is a Torah-specific instantiation of the broader 'holy strength / human initiative that draws down Divine blessing' cluster type. (2) The 'evil boldness / sitra achra obstruction' domain (Package 2) is likewise a well-established evil-mirror type. עזות פנים is Torah #147's specific name for the evil force that blocks Torah — structurally equivalent to יצר הרע (Torah #1), מלכות הרשעה, or other evil-domain packages across Likutay Moharan. (3) The teaching does NOT introduce a third package type (e.g., there is no 'neutrally structured' or 'mediating' concept cluster). The ענוה / humility concept introduced in lines 8-9 could theoretically form a 3rd concept, but the Rebbe explicitly sets it aside as 'ענין אחר לגמרי' without developing bechina connections for it in this Torah. With only 9 lines and 1 bechina edge in the dataset, Torah #147 is structurally too minimal to generate a novel package taxonomy. Its entire contribution is the specific Torah-local naming of the universal good/evil boldness polarity.
